titles.native: 魔法使いロゼの佐渡ライフ

description:
Rose escapes from her own world... and ends up on "Sado Island"? This is the start of a daily-life comedy where she and Sana, a girl who lives on the island, try to make the most of every day!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)
